exercises.instructions: Choose the correct verb form to complete each sentence.

questions.question: We ________ to the park every Sunday.
questions.explanation: Simple Present Affirmative: Subject + V1. "Every Sunday" indicates a regular habit, so we use Simple Present. "Went" is past and "will go" is future — neither fits a habitual action. Simple Present အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + V1။ "Every Sunday" ဆိုတာ ပုံမှန်အလေ့အကျင့်ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် Simple Present ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: We ________ to the park because it is raining.
questions.explanation: Simple Present Negative: Subject + don't + V1. The reason "because it is raining" gives a present-tense negative context. "Go" is affirmative and "went" is past — neither fits the negative present meaning. Simple Present ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + don't + V1။

questions.question: ________ to the park every Sunday?
questions.explanation: Simple Present Interrogative: Do + subject + V1? Simple Present မေးခွန်းပုံ - Do + subject + V1?

questions.question: ________ to the park every Sunday?
questions.explanation: Simple Present Negative Interrogative: Don't + subject + V1? Simple Present ငြင်းဆိုမေးခွန်း - Don't + subject + V1?

questions.question: You ________ in the river yesterday.
questions.explanation: Simple Past Affirmative: Subject + V2. "Yesterday" indicates past time. Simple Past အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + V2။ "Yesterday" ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: You ________ in the river yesterday.
questions.explanation: Simple Past Negative: Subject + didn't + V1. Simple Past ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + didn't + V1။

questions.question: ________ in the river yesterday?
questions.explanation: Simple Past Interrogative: Did + subject + V1? Simple Past မေးခွန်းပုံ - Did + subject + V1?

questions.question: ________ in the river yesterday?
questions.explanation: Simple Past Negative Interrogative: Didn't + subject + V1? Simple Past ငြင်းဆိုမေးခွန်း - Didn't + subject + V1?

questions.question: It ________ tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: Simple Future Affirmative: Subject + will + V1. "Tomorrow morning" indicates future time. Simple Future အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + will + V1။ "Tomorrow morning" ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: It ________ tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: Simple Future Negative: Subject + won't + V1. Simple Future ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + won't + V1။

questions.question: ________ tomorrow morning?
questions.explanation: Simple Future Interrogative: Will + subject + V1? Simple Future မေးခွန်းပုံ - Will + subject + V1?

questions.question: ________ tomorrow morning?
questions.explanation: Simple Future Negative Interrogative: Won't + subject + V1? Simple Future ငြင်းဆိုမေးခွန်း - Won't + subject + V1?

questions.question: He ________ in Yangon now.
questions.explanation: Simple Present Affirmative (he/she/it): Subject + V1 + s. "Now" indicates present time. "Lived" is past and "will live" is future — neither fits the present context. Simple Present အတည်ပြုပုံ (he/she/it) - Subject + V1 + s။

questions.question: He ________ in Yangon anymore.
questions.explanation: Simple Present Negative (he/she/it): Subject + doesn't + V1. "Anymore" indicates a present negative state. "Lives" is affirmative and "didn't live" is past — neither fits the present negative meaning with "anymore". Simple Present ငြင်းဆိုပုံ (he/she/it) - Subject + doesn't + V1။

questions.question: ________ he live in Yangon?
questions.explanation: Simple Present Interrogative (he/she/it): Does + subject + V1? "Does" is the correct auxiliary for third person singular in present tense. "Do" is for I/you/we/they and "Did" is for past. Simple Present မေးခွန်းပုံ (he/she/it) - Does + subject + V1?

questions.question: ________ he live in Yangon next year?
questions.explanation: Simple Future Negative Interrogative: Won't + subject + V1? "Next year" indicates future time, so we use "Won't". "Doesn't" is present and "Didn't" is past — neither fits the future context. Simple Future ငြင်းဆိုမေးခွန်း - Won't + subject + V1?

questions.question: She ________ three years ago.
questions.explanation: Simple Past Affirmative: Subject + V2. "Three years ago" indicates past time. Simple Past အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + V2။ "Three years ago" ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: She ________ three years ago.
questions.explanation: Simple Past Negative: Subject + didn't + V1. Simple Past ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + didn't + V1။

questions.question: ________ three years ago?
questions.explanation: Simple Past Interrogative: Did + subject + V1? Simple Past မေးခွန်းပုံ - Did + subject + V1?

questions.question: ________ three years ago?
questions.explanation: Simple Past Negative Interrogative: Didn't + subject + V1? Simple Past ငြင်းဆိုမေးခွန်း - Didn't + subject + V1?

questions.question: He ________ next year.
questions.explanation: Simple Future Affirmative: Subject + will + V1. "Next year" indicates future time. Simple Future အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + will + V1။ "Next year" ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: He ________ next year.
questions.explanation: Simple Future Negative: Subject + won't + V1. Simple Future ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + won't + V1။

questions.question: ________ next year?
questions.explanation: Simple Future Interrogative: Will + subject + V1? Simple Future မေးခွန်းပုံ - Will + subject + V1?

questions.question: ________ next year?
questions.explanation: Simple Future Negative Interrogative: Won't + subject + V1? Simple Future ငြင်းဆိုမေးခွန်း - Won't + subject + V1?

questions.question: Do we go to the park every Sunday? Yes, ________.
questions.explanation: The question uses 'Do' (Simple Present) with 'every Sunday', so the short answer must also be Simple Present: 'we do'. မေးခွန်းက 'Do' (Simple Present) နဲ့ 'every Sunday' သုံးထားတဲ့အတွက် အဖြေကလည်း Simple Present 'we do' ဖြစ်ရပါမယ်။

questions.question: Do we go to the park every Sunday? No, ________.
questions.explanation: The question uses 'Do' (Simple Present) with 'every Sunday', so the short negative answer must be 'we don't'. မေးခွန်းက 'Do' (Simple Present) နဲ့ 'every Sunday' သုံးထားတဲ့အတွက် အဖြေက 'we don't' ဖြစ်ရပါမယ်။

questions.question: Did we go to the park yesterday? Yes, ________.
questions.explanation: The question uses 'Did' (Simple Past) with 'yesterday', so the short answer must be 'we did'. မေးခွန်းက 'Did' (Simple Past) နဲ့ 'yesterday' သုံးထားတဲ့အတွက် အဖြေက 'we did' ဖြစ်ရပါမယ်။

questions.question: Did we go to the park yesterday? No, ________.
questions.explanation: The question uses 'Did' (Simple Past) with 'yesterday', so the short negative answer must be 'we didn't'. မေးခွန်းက 'Did' (Simple Past) နဲ့ 'yesterday' သုံးထားတဲ့အတွက် အဖြေက 'we didn't' ဖြစ်ရပါမယ်။

questions.question: Will we go to the park tomorrow? Yes, ________.
questions.explanation: The question uses 'Will' (Simple Future) with 'tomorrow', so the short answer must be 'we will'. မေးခွန်းက 'Will' (Simple Future) နဲ့ 'tomorrow' သုံးထားတဲ့အတွက် အဖြေက 'we will' ဖြစ်ရပါမယ်။

questions.question: Will we go to the park tomorrow? No, ________.
questions.explanation: The question uses 'Will' (Simple Future) with 'tomorrow', so the short negative answer must be 'we won't'. မေးခွန်းက 'Will' (Simple Future) နဲ့ 'tomorrow' သုံးထားတဲ့အတွက် အဖြေက 'we won't' ဖြစ်ရပါမယ်။

questions.question: Does he live in Yangon? Yes, ________.
questions.explanation: The question uses 'Does' (Simple Present, he/she/it), so the short answer must be 'he does'. မေးခွန်းက 'Does' (Simple Present, he/she/it) သုံးထားတဲ့အတွက် အဖြေက 'he does' ဖြစ်ရပါမယ်။

questions.question: Does he live in Yangon? No, ________.
questions.explanation: The question uses 'Does' (Simple Present, he/she/it), so the short negative answer must be 'he doesn't'. မေးခွန်းက 'Does' (Simple Present, he/she/it) သုံးထားတဲ့အတွက် အဖြေက 'he doesn't' ဖြစ်ရပါမယ်။

questions.question: Did he live in Yangon three years ago? Yes, ________.
questions.explanation: The question uses 'Did' (Simple Past) with 'three years ago', so the short answer must be 'he did'. မေးခွန်းက 'Did' (Simple Past) နဲ့ 'three years ago' သုံးထားတဲ့အတွက် အဖြေက 'he did' ဖြစ်ရပါမယ်။

questions.question: Did he live in Yangon three years ago? No, ________.
questions.explanation: The question uses 'Did' (Simple Past) with 'three years ago', so the short negative answer must be 'he didn't'. မေးခွန်းက 'Did' (Simple Past) နဲ့ 'three years ago' သုံးထားတဲ့အတွက် အဖြေက 'he didn't' ဖြစ်ရပါမယ်။

questions.question: Will he live in Yangon next year? Yes, ________.
questions.explanation: The question uses 'Will' (Simple Future) with 'next year', so the short answer must be 'he will'. မေးခွန်းက 'Will' (Simple Future) နဲ့ 'next year' သုံးထားတဲ့အတွက် အဖြေက 'he will' ဖြစ်ရပါမယ်။

questions.question: They ________ to Bagan last month.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense of 'go' is 'went'. 'Last month' indicates past time. go ရဲ့ V2 က went ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ 'Last month' ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: You ________ at Mandalay next month.
questions.explanation: 'Next month' indicates future time, so we use 'will + V1'. 'Next month' ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် will + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She doesn't ________ loudly.
questions.explanation: After 'doesn't', we use the base form (V1). doesn't ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Her brother ________ all the time.
questions.explanation: Simple Present with 'he' (her brother) uses 'V1 + s'. 'All the time' indicates a habitual action in present. he နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ V1 + s ကိုသုံးပါ။ 'All the time' ဆိုတာ ပုံမှန်အလေ့အကျင့်ကိုဖော်ပြပါတယ်။

questions.question: Do you think he will ________ you?
questions.explanation: After 'will', we use the base form (V1). will ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I always ________ in the winter.
questions.explanation: Simple Present with 'I' uses the base form (V1). 'Always' indicates a habitual action. I နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။ 'Always' ဆိုတာ ပုံမှန်အလေ့အကျင့်ကိုဖော်ပြပါတယ်။

questions.question: She won't ________ him.
questions.explanation: After 'won't', we use the base form (V1). won't ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ she cry yesterday?
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' indicates past time, so we use 'Did'. မနေ့ကဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် Did ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: You can ________ it.
questions.explanation: After modal verbs like 'can', we use the base form (V1). can လို modal verb ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Don't you ________ your guitar?
questions.explanation: After 'Don't', we use the base form (V1). Don't ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ you like fizzy drinks every day?
questions.explanation: Simple Present with 'you' uses 'Do'. 'Every day' indicates present habitual time. 'Does' is for he/she/it and 'Did' is for past — neither fits. you နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ Do ကိုသုံးပါ။ 'Every day' ဆိုတာ ပုံမှန်အလေ့အကျင့်ကိုဖော်ပြပါတယ်။

questions.question: ________ in a small group and discuss your answers.
questions.explanation: Imperative form uses the base form (V1). အမိန့်ပေးသည့်ပုံစံမှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She ________ Greek Yoghurt every day.
questions.explanation: Simple Present with 'she' uses 'V1 + s'. 'Every day' indicates present habitual time. 'Love' doesn't agree with 'she' and 'loved' is past — neither fits. she နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ V1 + s ကိုသုံးပါ။ 'Every day' ဆိုတာ ပုံမှန်အလေ့အကျင့်ကိုဖော်ပြပါတယ်။

questions.question: The fans ________ the star outside the cinema last night.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense of 'meet' is 'met'. 'Last night' indicates past time. meet ရဲ့ V2 က met ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ 'Last night' ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: I ________ washing dishes every day.
questions.explanation: Simple Present with 'I' uses the base form (V1). 'Every day' indicates present habitual time. 'Hates' doesn't agree with 'I' and 'hated' is past — neither fits. I နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။ 'Every day' ဆိုတာ ပုံမှန်အလေ့အကျင့်ကိုဖော်ပြပါတယ်။

questions.question: Yesterday afternoon my sister ________ a chocolate cake.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense of 'make' is 'made'. 'Yesterday afternoon' indicates past time. make ရဲ့ V2 က made ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ 'Yesterday afternoon' ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: Susan ________ a new dress to the party last weekend.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense of 'wear' is 'wore'. 'Last weekend' indicates past time. wear ရဲ့ V2 က wore ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ 'Last weekend' ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: James and Alice ________ football next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 'Next Sunday' indicates future time, so we use 'will + V1'. 'Next Sunday' ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် will + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Polar bears ________ soon.
questions.explanation: 'Soon' indicates future time, so we use 'will + V1'. 'Soon' ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် will + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ you see the new TV series last night?
questions.explanation: 'Last night' indicates past time, so we use 'Did'. မနေ့ညကဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် Did ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I am taking an umbrella because the weather forecast said that it ________ later.
questions.explanation: 'Later' indicates future time, so we use 'will + V1'. 'Later' ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် will + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I ________ an eagle while I was walking in the mountains.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense of 'see' is 'saw'. 'While I was walking' indicates past time. see ရဲ့ V2 က saw ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ 'While I was walking' ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလကိုဖော်ပြပါတယ်။

questions.question: It ________ your vocabularies every day.
questions.explanation: Simple Present with 'it' uses 'V1 + s'. 'Every day' indicates present habitual time. 'Increase' doesn't agree with 'it' and 'increased' is past — neither fits. it နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ V1 + s ကိုသုံးပါ။ 'Every day' ဆိုတာ ပုံမှန်အလေ့အကျင့်ကိုဖော်ပြပါတယ်။

questions.question: I ________ coffee when I was 11.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense because 'when I was 11' indicates past time. 'When I was 11' ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် V2 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I didn't ________ sport last weekend.
questions.explanation: After 'didn't', we use the base form (V1). didn't ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: ကျွန်မ မင်းကို ယုံတယ်။ (I / you / believe in)
questions.explanation: Simple Present Affirmative: Subject + V1 + object. 'တယ်' indicates present affirmative. Simple Present အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + V1 + object။

questions.question: မင်း ငါ့ကို ကူညီမလား။ (you / me / help)
questions.explanation: Simple Future Interrogative: Will + subject + V1? 'မလား' indicates future question. Simple Future မေးခွန်းပုံ - Will + subject + V1?

questions.question: သူမ မနက်ဖန် ကျောင်းသို့ သွားမှာမယ်။ (She / tomorrow / go to school)
options: She will go to school tomorrow.
She didn't go to school tomorrow.
questions.answer: She will go to school tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Simple Future Affirmative: Subject + will + V1. 'Tomorrow' and 'မှာမယ်' indicate future. Simple Future အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + will + V1။

questions.question: သူ ငါ့ကို မမှတ်မိခဲ့ပါ။ (He / me / forgot)
questions.explanation: Simple Past Negative: Subject + didn't + V1. 'ခဲ့ပါ။' indicates past negative. Simple Past ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + didn't + V1။

questions.question: မင်းတို့ ပန်းကန် မဆေးဘူးလား။ (you / wash the dishes)
questions.explanation: Simple Present Negative Interrogative: Don't + subject + V1? 'ဘူးလား' indicates a negative question in present. Simple Present ငြင်းဆိုမေးခွန်း - Don't + subject + V1?

questions.question: မနေ့က သူမ အဝတ်တွေ မညှစ်တက်ခဲ့လား။ (she / yesterday / iron the clothes)
options: Did she iron the clothes yesterday?
Does she iron the clothes yesterday?
Will she iron the clothes yesterday?
questions.answer: Did she iron the clothes yesterday?
questions.explanation: Simple Past Interrogative: Did + subject + V1? 'မနေ့က' indicates past. Simple Past မေးခွန်းပုံ - Did + subject + V1?

questions.question: သူမ မင်းရဲ့ပန်းသီး ကို စားမှာ မဟုတ်ဘူး။ (She / eat / your apples)
questions.explanation: Simple Future Negative: Subject + won't + V1. 'မှာ မဟုတ်ဘူး' indicates future negative. Simple Future ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + won't + V1။

questions.question: သူ ဂျာမနီမှာ မနေဘူး မဟုတ်လား။ (he / in Germany / live)
questions.explanation: Simple Present Negative Interrogative: Doesn't + subject + V1? 'ဘူးလား' indicates a negative question in present. Simple Present ငြင်းဆိုမေးခွန်း - Doesn't + subject + V1?

questions.question: သူမက အင်္ဂလိပ်သဒ္ဒါကို တခြားသူတွေနဲ့ မျှဝတယ်။ (She / English grammar / share / to other)
options: She shares English grammar with others.
She shared English grammar with others.
She will share English grammar with others.
questions.answer: She shares English grammar with others.
questions.explanation: Simple Present Affirmative: Subject + V1 + s. 'တယ်' indicates present affirmative. Simple Present အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + V1 + s။

questions.question: သူတို့ ဒီနေ့ အတန်းမတက်ခဲ့ဘူး။ (They / today / attend the class)
options: They didn't attend the class today.
They don't attend the class today.
They won't attend the class today.
questions.answer: They didn't attend the class today.
questions.explanation: Simple Past Negative: Subject + didn't + V1. 'ခဲ့ဘူး' indicates past negative. Simple Past ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + didn't + V1။

questions.question: ငါတို့ မင်းကို နားလည်မှားခဲ့ကတယ်။ (We / you / misunderstood)
questions.explanation: Simple Past Affirmative: Subject + V2. 'ခဲ့ကတယ်' indicates past. Simple Past အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + V2။

questions.question: မင်း အစောရုံ စောစော မထဘူးလား။ (you / get up early)
questions.explanation: Simple Present Negative Interrogative: Don't + subject + V1? 'ဘူးလား' indicates a negative question in present. Simple Present ငြင်းဆိုမေးခွန်း - Don't + subject + V1?

questions.question: မကြာခင် သူ ဘူတာကို ရောက်လာမှာမယ်။ (soon / he / arrive at the station)
options: He will arrive at the station soon.
He arrives at the station soon.
He didn't arrive at the station soon.
questions.answer: He will arrive at the station soon.
questions.explanation: Simple Future Affirmative: Subject + will + V1. 'မကြာခင်' and 'မှာမယ်' indicate future. Simple Future အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + will + V1။

questions.question: သူမ သူ့ကို မချစ်ချပါဘူး။ (She / him / love)
questions.explanation: Simple Present Negative: Subject + doesn't + V1. 'ပါဘူး' indicates present negative. Simple Present ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + doesn't + V1။

questions.question: သူတို့ မနက်ဖန် ဘောလုံးကန်ကြမှာမယ်။ (They / tomorrow / play the football)
questions.explanation: Simple Future Affirmative: Subject + will + V1. 'မနက်ဖန်' and 'မှာမယ်' indicate future. Simple Future အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + will + V1။
